column11: judgement on filed timing: enrolment and dosing in the Phase 2 are complete (Q3 2026 10-Q 0001193125-26-449901) and no registrational study is registered or described. Arcturus held a type C meeting on a proposed paediatric study under the Rare Disease Evidence Principles (FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-088391) and plans to fold the next-generation ARCT-2601 into the same Phase 2 protocol from Q1 2027. A registrational study starting in 2028 and reading out in 2030, then a priority review of an original BLA, 60 days plus 6 months on data/fda_review_clock.csv (PDUFA VII I.A.1.b and I.B.4), puts approval in 2031 with 2032 the first full year
column12: Case for earlier: fast track and rare paediatric disease designations are granted, and the Rare Disease Evidence Principles pathway is built for exactly this kind of programme.
